declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan
declarations.source_statement: def readPlan (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β) : Protocol n α β

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_query
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_query (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (history : Transcript n α) (i : Fin n)
    (query : indices[history.length]? = some i) :
    readPlan indices compute history = Sum.inr i

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_done
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_done (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (history : Transcript n α) (done : indices[history.length]? = none) :
    readPlan indices compute history = Sum.inl (compute (history.reverse.map Prod.snd))

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_run_from
declarations.source_statement:
private theorem readPlan_run_from (input : Fin n → α) (compute : List α → β)
    (prefix remaining : List (Fin n)) :
    Runs (readPlan (prefix ++ remaining) compute) input
      (prefix.map (fun i => (i, input i))).reverse
      (remaining.map (fun i => (i, input i)))
      (compute ((prefix ++ remaining).map input))

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_run (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (input : Fin n → α) :
    Runs (readPlan indices compute) input []
      (indices.map (fun i => (i, input i))) (compute (indices.map input))

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_total
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_total (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β) :
    Total (readPlan indices compute)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_run_iff
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_run_iff (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (input : Fin n → α) (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β) :
    Runs (readPlan indices compute) input [] trace value ↔
      trace = indices.map (fun i => (i, input i)) ∧
        value = compute (indices.map input)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_length
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_length (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (input : Fin n → α) (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readPlan indices compute) input [] trace value) :
    trace.length = indices.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_work
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readPlan_work (indices : List (Fin n)) (compute : List α → β)
    (input : Fin n → α) (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readPlan indices compute) input [] trace value) (c : Nat) :
    queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * indices.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll
declarations.source_statement: def readAll (compute : List α → β) : Protocol n α β

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_run (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α) :
    Runs (readAll compute) input [] (List.ofFn (fun i => (i, input i)))
      (compute (List.ofFn input))

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_total
declarations.source_statement: theorem readAll_total (compute : List α → β) : Total (readAll (n

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_run_iff
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_run_iff (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α)
    (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β) :
    Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value ↔
      trace = List.ofFn (fun i => (i, input i)) ∧ value = compute (List.ofFn input)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_coordinates
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_coordinates (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α)
    (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) :
    trace.map Prod.fst = List.finRange n

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_length
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_length (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α)
    (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) : trace.length = n

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_work
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_work (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α)
    (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) (c : Nat) :
    queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * n

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readAll_correct
declarations.source_statement:
theorem readAll_correct (compute : List α → β) (spec : List α → β → Prop)
    (correct : ∀ xs : List α, xs.length = n → spec xs (compute xs))
    (input : Fin n → α) (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) :
    spec (List.ofFn input) value

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.empty_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem empty_run (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin 0 → α) :
    Runs (readAll compute) input [] [] (compute [])

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.empty_every_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem empty_every_run (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin 0 → α)
    (trace : Transcript 0 α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) (c : Nat) :
    trace = [] ∧ value = compute [] ∧ queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = 0

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.full_read_exists
declarations.source_statement:
theorem full_read_exists (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α) (c : Nat) :
    ∃ (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β),
      Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value ∧
      trace.map Prod.fst = List.finRange n ∧
      value = compute (List.ofFn input) ∧ trace.length = n ∧
      queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * n

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.full_read_every_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem full_read_every_run (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin n → α)
    (trace : Transcript n α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readAll compute) input [] trace value) (c : Nat) :
    trace = List.ofFn (fun i => (i, input i)) ∧
      value = compute (List.ofFn input) ∧ trace.length = n ∧
      queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * n

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.observed_sum
declarations.source_statement:
theorem observed_sum (input : Fin n → Nat) (trace : Transcript n Nat) (value : Nat)
    (run : Runs (readAll (fun xs : List Nat => xs.sum)) input [] trace value) :
    value = (List.ofFn input).sum

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.concrete_full_read
declarations.source_statement:
theorem concrete_full_read :
    Runs (readAll (fun xs : List Nat => xs.sum)) (![8, 3, 5] : Fin 3 → Nat) []
      [(0, 8), (1, 3), (2, 5)] 16

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.duplicate_full_read
declarations.source_statement:
theorem duplicate_full_read :
    Runs (readAll (fun xs : List Nat => xs.sum)) (![4, 4, 4] : Fin 3 → Nat) []
      [(0, 4), (1, 4), (2, 4)] 12

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.duplicate_every_charge
declarations.source_statement:
theorem duplicate_every_charge (trace : Transcript 3 Nat) (value : Nat)
    (run : Runs (readAll (fun xs : List Nat => xs.sum))
      (![4, 4, 4] : Fin 3 → Nat) [] trace value) :
    value = 12 ∧ trace.length = 3 ∧ queryWork (fun _ _ => 2) trace = 6

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.repeated_plan_run
declarations.source_statement:
theorem repeated_plan_run (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin 2 → α) :
    Runs (readPlan [0, 1, 0] compute) input []
      [(0, input 0), (1, input 1), (0, input 0)]
      (compute [input 0, input 1, input 0])

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.repeated_plan_every_charge
declarations.source_statement:
theorem repeated_plan_every_charge (compute : List α → β) (input : Fin 2 → α)
    (trace : Transcript 2 α) (value : β)
    (run : Runs (readPlan [0, 1, 0] compute) input [] trace value) (c : Nat) :
    value = compute [input 0, input 1, input 0] ∧ trace.length = 3 ∧
      queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * 3

declarations.name: Examples.CoordinateReadAll.supplied_history_values
declarations.source_statement:
theorem supplied_history_values :
    readPlan ([0, 1] : List (Fin 2)) (fun xs : List Nat => xs)
      [(0, 99), (1, 7)] = Sum.inl [7, 99]
